name: Lifeplus+
source:
It's about hunting down a gemstone with your companions, Natur and Latit - You click where you want to search, but you can also use your keyboard.

The story is mostly told through conversations - It's only 1600 words, but due to the nature of the game you might not get to read all of them.

If you get the gemstone on your first try you might want to buy a lottery ticket or something today XD

The game can take anywhere between 4mins and 40mins to play. If you see the credits in game then you've got to the proper end.

[From  [url=https://sleepyagents.itch.io/lifeplus]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述你与伙伴纳图尔和拉蒂特一起寻找宝石。点击想搜索的位置，也可以使用键盘。

故事主要通过对话讲述——总共只有1600字，但由于游戏性质，你可能无法读完全部内容。

如果第一次就找到宝石，也许今天该去买彩票或做点类似的事XD

游戏时长在4分钟到40分钟之间。如果在游戏中看到了制作人员名单，就说明你到达了真正结局。

[来源：[url=https://sleepyagents.itch.io/lifeplus]itch.io[/url]]
